channel.title: The Local France - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Local France (thelocal.fr)

item.title: 'Made in Europe': New push to buy European causes splits in bloc
item.description: Everyone in Europe agrees the EU needs to rescue its industry but the bloc is split over how far it should push a 'Buy European' approach in order to do so.

item.title: France loosens rules on allowing farmers to shoot wolves
item.description: The French government said Monday it would authorise the shooting of wolves that attack livestock even outside protected enclosures, a policy shift welcomed by farmers, a powerful and increasingly disgruntled constituency.

item.title: French expression of the day: Faire pleurer dans les chaumières
item.description: This French expression doesn't have anything to do with cottages anymore.

item.title: Départements in western France remain on red alert for flooding
item.description: Météo France has maintained three départements in western France on red alert for flooding until Wednesday.

item.title: Will British dual nationals really be forced to have a valid UK passport from February 25th?
item.description: The UK's new border control system ETA reaches a new phase in February - but will British dual nationals really be denied entry to the country if they do not have a valid UK passport?

item.title: 'A money making racket': Angry British dual nationals blast UK passport demand
item.description: With the end of the Electronic Travel Authorisation system's 'tolerance period' approaching, British readers of The Local have slammed unclear government guidance about a rule change meaning dual nationals must enter the country on a valid UK passport.

item.title: Charles de Gaulle airport ends shuttle bus service to Paris
item.description: The RoissyBus shuttle linking central Paris to Charles de Gaulle airport will make its final journey on Saturday, February 28th, ending a long-standing service operated by RATP.

item.title: Two more skiers die in avalanche in French Alps
item.description: Another two skiers have lost their lives while skiing off-piste in the French Alps, just days after an avalanche killed three in the same mountains.

item.title: French grammar tip: Figuring out direct and indirect objects
item.description: Differentiation between COD (direct object) and COI (indirect object) can be tedious, but once you've understood the basic rules, things get a lot simpler!

item.title: France arrests nine over far-right activist's killing
item.description: French authorities on Tuesday arrested nine suspects over the killing last week of a far-right activist, including an assistant to a hard-left member of parliament, a prosecutor and an informed source said.
